label: FortiGate 80F
description: Fortinet FortiGate 80F - 10/100/1000 GE desktop firewall: 6x GE RJ45 internal ports, 2x GE RJ45 FortiLink ports and two shared-media WAN positions that accept either GE RJ45 or a GE SFP cage (WAN1/SFP1 and WAN2/SFP2, one cable per position).
notes: FortiGate 80F data sheet, Interfaces and Modules: 2 x GE RJ45/SFP shared media pairs, 6 x GE RJ45 internal ports, 2 x GE RJ45 FortiLink ports (default); front panel callouts: "1. 2 x GE RJ45/SFP Shared Media Ports 2. 6 x GE RJ45 Ports 3. 2 x GE RJ45 FortiLink Ports"; ordering line "8 x GE RJ45 ports, 2 x RJ45/SFP shared media WAN ports". SFP1/WAN1 and SFP2/WAN2 are each one physical connector, so they are modelled as combo pairs like the FortiGate 100F and 90G. sfp1/sfp2 previously had no connector, which made them 1G copper ports that a fibre link could never reach.
